title: Separated descended model used in the final assembly
statement:
Let $S$ be quasi-compact and quasi-separated and let $Y\to S$ be
separated and of finite presentation. Retain the supplied
$N=\mathsf N_f=\mathsf N(S)$ of [def-nagata-final-noetherian-base-system].
Present this system in the directed-preorder form used by
[def-nagata-separated-descent-stage]: a nonempty directed preorder $I$,
a diagram $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Scheme}$ with affine transitions,
a limit cone $c$ with vertex $S$, and a functor $F:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to N.I$
with a natural isomorphism $\alpha:D\simeq F\circ N.D$ such that
$c_\lambda\circ\alpha_\lambda=N.\pi_{F(\lambda)}$.
Retain the constructed relative gluing datum, its valid stage, and its
finite-presentation gluing model, structure map and comparison, together
with the finite-presentation and isomorphism properties needed to apply
the separated-descent construction. Define
$$\lambda_Y=\lambda_{\mathrm{sep}}(Y/S),\qquad
Y_{\lambda_Y}=Y^{\mathrm{sep}}_{\lambda_Y}.$$
The structure map is the selected model's base-change projection.
Let $\epsilon_Y:Y_{\lambda_Y}\times_{D(\lambda_Y)}S\to Y$
be the canonical reassociation of this iterated pullback, using the cone
compatibility equation, followed by the constructed finite-presentation
comparison. The stages $D(\lambda)$ are identified by $\alpha$ with
$N.D(F(\lambda))$; their Noetherian properties are those of
[lemma-nagata-final-noetherian-base-system].

statement_change.what: N.I is only a cofiltered small category, not the directed preorder required by the landed separated-descent construction. The original statement also omitted the retained gluing choices and input properties of that construction, and did not specify the constructed comparison after the later base change. Record a directed presentation with its diagram and projection identifications and the existing construction inputs, and specify the comparison as the canonical pullback reassociation composite. No choice is made from an unproved existence theorem.
